schema.text: Has the lack of secure bicycle parking ever caused you to change your travel plans or leave your bike at home?

options.text: Always — lack of parking is a constant barrier to cycling

en.#Has the lack of secure bicycle parking: Has the lack of secure bicycle parking ever caused you to change your travel plans or leave your bike at home?
en.#Always — lack of parking is a constant: Always — lack of parking is a constant barrier to cycling

it.#Has the lack of secure bicycle parking: La mancanza di un parcheggio sicuro per biciclette ti ha mai portato a cambiare i tuoi programmi di viaggio o a lasciare la bicicletta a casa?
it.#Always — lack of parking is a constant: Sempre — la mancanza di parcheggi è un ostacolo costante all’uso della bicicletta

fr.#Has the lack of secure bicycle parking: Le manque de stationnement sûr pour les vélos vous a-t-il déjà poussé à changer vos plans de déplacement ou à laisser votre vélo chez vous ?
fr.#Always — lack of parking is a constant: Toujours — le manque de stationnement est un obstacle permanent à mes déplacements à vélo

de.#Has the lack of secure bicycle parking: Hat fehlendes sicheres Fahrradparken schon einmal dazu geführt, dass Sie Ihre Pläne geändert oder das Fahrrad zu Hause gelassen haben?
de.#Always — lack of parking is a constant: Immer — fehlende Abstellmöglichkeiten sind ein dauerhaftes Hindernis für mich

tr.#Has the lack of secure bicycle parking: Güvenli bisiklet parkının olmaması hiç yolculuk planınızı değiştirmenize veya bisikletinizi evde bırakmanıza neden oldu mu?
tr.#Always — lack of parking is a constant: Her zaman — park yeri eksikliği bisiklet kullanmam için sürekli bir engel

fa.#Has the lack of secure bicycle parking: آیا نبود جای پارک امن برای دوچرخه تا به حال باعث شده برنامه سفر خود را تغییر دهید یا دوچرخه را در خانه بگذارید؟
fa.#Always — lack of parking is a constant: همیشه — نبود پارک مناسب یک مانع دائمی برای دوچرخه‌سواری من است

hu.#Has the lack of secure bicycle parking: Előfordult már, hogy a biztonságos kerékpárparkoló hiánya miatt megváltoztatta az utazási tervét vagy otthon hagyta a kerékpárt?
hu.#Always — lack of parking is a constant: Mindig — a parkolóhely hiánya állandó akadály a kerékpározásban

ar.#Has the lack of secure bicycle parking: هل سبق أن دفعك عدم وجود موقف آمن للدراجة إلى تغيير خطة سفرك أو ترك الدراجة في المنزل؟
ar.#Always — lack of parking is a constant: دائمًا — نقص مواقف الدراجات عائق مستمر بالنسبة لي
